Subject: Important Reminder Regarding Client Meeting Punctuality

Dear Team,

I want to take a moment to emphasize the importance of punctuality for all client meetings. Being on time is a fundamental aspect of our professional image, and it reflects directly on the quality and reliability of our services.

We have noticed a pattern of tardiness in recent weeks, which is concerning. It is crucial that we address this immediately to maintain the high standards our clients expect from us. Please ensure that you are arriving at meetings on time moving forward. Consistent lateness is not acceptable and may lead to further disciplinary measures.

Let’s all make a conscious effort to respect our clients' time and uphold our company’s reputation for professionalism.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
